Business Psychology graduate (UC San Diego) working in consumer insights and
market research. I design surveys, segment customers, and analyze consumer text
at scale — then write the recommendation someone can actually act on.

Based in Oceanside, CA. Fluent in Spanish and English.

## Featured work

**Consumer Complaint Classification at Scale - Coca-Cola Zero**

Classified 57,000+ consumer posts into 16 complaint categories using an R and
LLM API pipeline, then measured how complaint volume shifted around two product
reformulations. Delivered as a one-page recommendation for brand leadership.
